summary: Iteration 9: Tested GPT Vision bill extraction for JPEG/PNG images. All features working correctly. AI Vision extracts provider, amount, due_date, biller_code, reference_number, account_number with spaces preserved. Frontend shows 'AI Vision — Details Extracted' badge.
critical_code_review_comments: GPT Vision extraction via emergentintegrations OpenAI gpt-4o is working correctly for JPEG and PNG images
Spaces in account numbers and reference numbers are preserved (e.g., '1234 5678 9012')
Frontend AccurassiBillExtractor correctly displays 'AI Vision — Details Extracted' for image uploads
Frontend description shows '(AI Vision + PDF)' indicating both extraction methods are available
Biller Code and Reference Number fields are present in the extraction form
PDF extraction via pdfplumber also working with improved regex patterns for BPAY fields
seed_data_creation: Created test bill images with PIL for testing GPT Vision extraction
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 complete. GPT Vision bill extraction for images is fully functional. Key features verified: 1) JPEG/PNG images are processed via GPT Vision (gpt-4o) instead of returning 'manual entry required', 2) extraction_method='ai_vision' for images, 3) Spaces preserved in account_number and reference_number, 4) Frontend shows 'AI Vision — Details Extracted' badge, 5) GET /api/accurassi/status returns ocr_available=true when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set. The EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is configured in /app/backend/.env.
